# Final prompt — built-in image generation

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: premium conceptual software mockup image for the right half of Cloudfianz's website hero. Create a square image, high resolution. It will appear at approximately 500px wide alongside a separate headline. Do not draw a website, a headline or a logo.
Primary request: represent custom business software, connecting a commercial quote to day-to-day project delivery and business visibility, in one thoughtful product composition.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid dark navy #0B1D3A, including all outer edges. No glow, no gradient, no decorative backdrop.
Subject and composition: a carefully art-directed close-up of three connected interface excerpts. One dominant near-front-facing ivory application panel centered slightly right, titled "Operación", with three spacious stage columns titled "Por iniciar", "En curso", "Completado". Show only one refined task tile per column, with restrained geometric content, small circular avatars without faces and one precise progress bar; no tiny prose. In the lower left foreground, partially overlapping without obscuring the main title, a compact white quotation panel titled "Cotización", with two clean item rows labelled "Servicios" and "Implementación", followed by one pale mint status pill "Aprobada". In the upper right foreground, a small mint panel titled "Resultados" with a beautifully proportioned simple bar chart in dark teal, no numerical axes or unsupported percentage claims. The three panels must clearly read as parts of the same software system, not separate devices. The central operation panel has the most visual weight. Close crop of product excerpts, generous internal spacing, beautiful alignment. All panels contained within image with 5 percent outer breathing room. Do not include a full dashboard, sidebar, navigation menu or many tiny widgets.
Style/medium: immaculate high-fidelity product UI mockup, razor-sharp typography and edges, subtle physical layering with soft natural shadows and very slight perspective only; typography remains straight and fully readable. Editorial SaaS product presentation with the care of a senior product designer. Restrained 12px equivalent rounded corners, no pill-shaped large cards.
Color palette: navy #0B1D3A, ivory white #FAFCFC, soft mint #E8F4F0, teal #12B5A5, secondary slate #55616F. No purple, neon lime or saturated blue.
Text (verbatim): "Operación", "Por iniciar", "En curso", "Completado", "Cotización", "Servicios", "Implementación", "Aprobada", "Resultados". These are the ONLY words allowed. Use clean contemporary sans-serif typography, similar to Manrope and Inter. All words spelled exactly with accents. Use short subtle lines or geometric UI marks for anything else, never invented text.
Constraints: This is a conceptual product illustration, not a screenshot of a real client. No brand logos, no company names, no fake customer data, no financial figures, no claimed performance metrics. No computer or phone hardware, hands, people, robots, code, floating generic icons, big arrows, orbit lines, glossy 3D blobs, watermark or explanatory caption. Make the image clear and compelling at small hero size.
